Appointment request

Request an appointment.

Tell us a bit about what's bringing you in and we'll call you within one business day to confirm a time. Visits are typically scheduled 1–6 weeks out depending on the provider and the concern.

This form is for non-urgent appointment requests.

It is not monitored in real time. We respond by phone within one business day. New patient visits are typically scheduled 1–6 weeks out depending on which provider and the type of visit.

For urgent same-day concerns, please call (503) 555-1870.

Suspected infection, worsening surgical site, severe medication reaction, or any clinically urgent dermatologic issue — call us directly. For appropriate concerns, a telehealth visit can sometimes be scheduled the same day. For life-threatening emergencies, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department.
